label: Product Showcase
description: Production package for asset-led product walkthrough scenes where embeddable UI media is the first-viewport signal and non-embeddable assets are represented truthfully.
avoidFor: scenes without embeddable product or UI assets
pure brand marketing pages where copy is the subject
metric-heavy dashboards that need dense tables rather than product media

renderCost.notes: The renderer composes product media, asset binding guards, deterministic crops, feature labels, and before-after states without network fetches.

reducedMotion.notes: Reduced mode shortens travel and the edge fixture uses static mode while keeping product and placeholder state visible.

accessibility.notes: High-contrast text, visible asset status labels, bounded feature cards, and clear placeholder copy preserve review readability.

directorCompatibility.selectionReason: Choose when narration depends on showing an actual embeddable product/UI asset, a focused feature callout, or a truthful before-after comparison.
hardBlocks: requires third-party logo or screenshot reuse without clearance

sourcePolicy.notes: Review media is generated from original SVG fixture mockups. No third-party product screenshot, logo, copied brand identity, font binary, or external image is registered.

knownLimitations: Shared registry and app-root availability remain untouched because they are outside this ownership slice.
16:9 support is metadata-ready only; this task renders portrait review frames only.
Review media uses original SVG data URI mockups instead of third-party product screenshots.
Stable promotion requires human visual approval.
